calculated_metrics: Per lead and threshold only. No means, averages, or cross-lead/threshold aggregation.

transition_definitions.false_alarms_new: ORIGINAL forecast < threshold, reference < threshold, candidate forecast >= threshold
transition_definitions.false_alarms_removed: ORIGINAL forecast >= threshold, reference < threshold, candidate forecast < threshold
transition_definitions.hits_gained: ORIGINAL forecast < threshold, reference >= threshold, candidate forecast >= threshold
transition_definitions.hits_lost: ORIGINAL forecast >= threshold, reference >= threshold, candidate forecast < threshold

weak_floor.rule: CSI(candidate) >= CSI(ORIGINAL) with zero tolerance for every lead and weak threshold
